items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:33:1
items.html: The letters of ZON are Shatnez Gatz: The allusion in this is to phase four, which became mixed into their vessels, and this mixture is called by the name Shatnez, which is the dross. (As above, page 486, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “The dross,” see there.) And Gatz alludes to the sparks that descended in order to enliven the vessels.
